body.x: E FUN has announced the next model in its Google Play Series, the Nextbook 8GP, to be introduced at CES. As with the other 7" model in the line, the 8" features Android 4.1 Jelly Bean, the Google Play Store, numerous preloaded Google apps, and a Dual Core 1.5GHz processor. The 8" model boasts a 9.5mm thickness and a high definition IPS screen, ideal for graphic intense applications and group viewing. Additional features include 1GB RAM, front and back cameras, 8GB internal memory, an HDMI-out port, and much more.
The Nextbook Google Play Series will be on display at CES in South Hall MP25067. E FUN will also be exhibiting at ShowStoppers on Tuesday, Jan 8.
For more information, visit at www.pc-w.com/ces2013
